predictions.rationale: Handles the textual notation for ActionState model elements, which are core nodes in UML Activity Diagrams.
UML-specific renderer/parsing of ActionState notation, directly supporting the visualization of Activity Diagram actions.
Manages notation for the ‘state’ of ObjectFlowState elements, which represent object tokens flowing through an Activity Diagram.
UML implementation of ObjectFlowState ‘state’ notation, refining Activity Diagram support for object flow semantics.
Provides notation for the ‘type’ facet of ObjectFlowState nodes, another key Activity Diagram concept.
UML-specific parsing/rendering of ObjectFlowState ‘type’ notation, completing Activity Diagram object flow representation.
Formats and parses transition labels; transitions connect activities and are essential edges in Activity Diagrams.
UML-specific implementation for transition notation, directly affecting how Activity Diagram flows are displayed.
Explorer navigation rule explicitly referencing ‘Activity’; helps locate Activity Diagram activities within the model tree.
Handles the body text of State nodes; Activity Diagrams reuse state notation for actions, so this supports displaying activity bodies.
